title: Independently verify the three published EIP-712 domain separators
problem: docs/EIP712-DOMAINS.md publishes name, version and DOMAIN_SEPARATOR for Base, Arbitrum and X Layer USDC, measured by the maintainer. A single measurement is not verification. If one of those three is wrong, every signature against that token fails silently and the document is actively harmful.
deliverables: An independent re-measurement of all three, with the block number used
A log entry recording agreement or disagreement
acceptance: All three values re-derived from a public RPC, not copied from the document
Any disagreement is stated plainly rather than smoothed over

required: raw RPC output for all three chains
the block number of each call
